encoder.pooling: attention-mask mean pooling followed by L2 normalization

modifierSensitivity.interpretation: Distance establishes whether the modifier changes the set; it does not by itself establish that the semantic direction is artistically correct.

lightnessDistribution.definition: mean absolute error between sorted physical OKLab lightness values

releaseDecision.note: Passing raw numeric gates is necessary but not sufficient. This entry point never promotes a checkpoint and does not evaluate the runtime lock guard, ONNX/browser parity, or blind human preference.

sanityOutputs.interpretation: Frozen scene/style outputs are saved for fixed-seed qualitative review; no human preference score is fabricated.
sanityOutputs.selectionPolicy: first seed in the frozen semantic fixture

crossSeed.definition: physical Hungarian mean OKLab set distance
